examples: Wait, I'm afraid there is a mistake with my booking.
That can't be right. I paid for this room on your website two weeks ago.
I think your system is wrong. I received a confirmation email.
But I have my confirmation number here. Is there a problem?
I'm quite sure the reservation was for today, not yesterday.
Could you check again? I am positive the error is not on my side.
Is it because I arrived late? But it's still tonight's booking.
If you don't have a room, maybe you can talk to your manager?
responses: I understand your concern, but my system shows the room was released after midnight. However, let me double-check our manager's overrides.
I apologize for the confusion. Let me see if there was a technical glitch on our end.
